answer: The island register is checked at draw time, relic lists the eligible set, and lantern seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 78 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 78 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. A farm of 232 pays that 81 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
